definitions.arrival_window_goodput: Payload received between first and last scheduled flow arrival, divided by this fixed per-manifest interval
definitions.fairness: Mean Jain index of per-sender delivered bytes in 100 ms bins with at least two senders each active for at least 50 ms. Descriptive proxy, demand-sensitive.
definitions.queue: Sample-based occupancy and delay from 1 ms simulator traces
definitions.overhead: Inference and control activity counts; not measured CPU time or network overhead
